    "# Time Series - Seasonal ensembles"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "se000001",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "A `SeasonalEnsemble` treats **the years of a single series as members of an ensemble**. All years are drawn over the same calendar, which shows the seasonal cycle, how much it varies between years, and how one year compares with the others.\n",
    "\n",
    "Covered here:\n",
    "\n",
    "- Getting the ensemble from a series\n",
    "- Highlighting a year\n",
    "- Labels of the x axis\n",
    "- Reducers and their dates\n",
    "- Water years\n",
    "- Monthly series and other time steps\n",
    "\n",
    "```{seealso}\n",
    "Check out the {doc}`Time Series - Ensembles <timeseries_10_ensemble>` tutorial first. Reducers, bands and highlights work the same way here.\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },

    "## Other time steps\n",
    "\n",
    "The ensemble works with monthly, daily and shorter steps, because these steps fall on the same calendar positions every year. Other steps, like weekly data, do not, so each date would hold only a few members. These raise an error:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "se000025",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": "Time step of 7 days 00:00:00 does not repeat each year. Use a monthly, daily or shorter step\n"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "weekly = TemperatureSeries(name=\"Weekly\")\n",
    "weekly.generate(start=\"2000-01-01\", end=\"2004-12-31\", freq=\"7D\", seed=1, inplace=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    weekly.get_seasonal_ensemble()\n",
    "except ValueError as e:\n",
    "    print(e)"

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "se000026",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Recap\n",
    "\n",
    "- `.get_seasonal_ensemble()` makes one member per year from a series, with incomplete years included.\n",
    "- Reducers, bands, `highlight` and `plot_background` work as in a `TimeSeriesEnsemble`, and members are named by year.\n",
    "- `view_specs[\"xaxis\"]` sets the labels: `month-alias`, `month-letter`, `month` or `days`.\n",
    "- Reducers return a `pandas.DataFrame` with one row per step of the year. Their dates, like those of the members, are placeholders of a leap reference year.\n",
    "- `year_start` sets the first month, for water years.\n",
    "- Time steps must repeat each year: monthly, daily or shorter."
   ]
  }
